capabilities: List related notes with matching excerpts and relevance scores
Insert suggested links under a See also heading, at the end, or at the cursor
Dismiss suggestions and clear or expire dismissals
Undo the last link that was added
Optionally explain each relation with a local LLM
extras: Desktop only; does not work on Obsidian mobile. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The Miyo Relay fallback and LLM rationale features are opt-in and off by default; the relay token is stored in plain text in the plugin data folder.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to surface notes worth linking while writing; finding related notes relies on memory or manual search, and this suggests candidates with excerpts and relevance scores.

relations.evidence: Vault Nexus needs the Miyo desktop app running on the same computer

summary: Link-suggestion panel that finds notes related to the one you are writing via a local Miyo index and inserts links you accept or dismiss.
